Senses.Explanation: Here the headword is either the act of lighting incense or the counted incense inside the longer one-stick-of-incense phrase; those grammatical units must not be treated as one undifferentiated noun. Monastic regulations use the headword as an instruction to light incense and report. Wuzhun Shifan’s record narrates going to the hall to light incense and bow; other records narrate lighting incense before a verse or dedication. Chijue Daochong says that his disciple Deyan lit incense to request the formal discourse. Counted one-stick constructions remain in the separate phrase entry, and a table-of-contents string is excluded.
